title: Test the caller-side stderr snapshot on startup timeout, admission budget, send failure and disconnect
outcome: Regression tests pin that the control-child stderr snapshot is taken before cleanup on each caller-side path: the startup-handshake timeout and disconnect in spawn_engram_control_process, the admission-budget path, send failure and the Disconnected reply. A later reordering of snapshot and terminate fails a test.
acceptance: Test the caller-side stderr snapshot on startup timeout, admission budget, send failure and disconnect is done
